note: Fixed before any training (DESIGN.md section 9). The scoring code reads this file.

jobs.label: Missing month (T unobserved, >= 8 of the other 11 observed)
Forecast T+1..T+3, onsets only (not in drought at T)
Estimation now where VCI changed most (top quartile of 1- or 3-month change)

selection_rule: best network = highest development within-fold AUC among network_families; best simple = highest among simple_models minus simple_exclude; best Bi-LSTM variant = highest among bilstm_variants
pass_rule: paired within-fold AUC difference (best network minus best simple) 95% interval entirely above zero over all regions AND neither the West nor the East paired interval entirely below zero

wording.above_zero_but_side_worse: did not pass (better overall, worse in the {side})
